name: IbanView
description: a read-only display of an International Bank Account Number (IBAN)
status: experimental — new, implemented and unit-tested in every headless library; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: No ARIA. A plain `<span>` cannot be named: `aria-label` is prohibited on it, and most screen readers drop it. A visible caption names the value, or the optional `label` renders as hidden text
`role="text"` so the identifier announces as a single unit
props: `label`: string (optional) — hidden text naming the value, in a `.screen-reader-span`. Leave it out when a visible caption names the value
`...restProps`: any additional HTML attributes spread onto the root
